pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark regions with sharp edge gradients. Geometry transitions from large, angular shapes on the neck to smaller, more rounded polygons on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with frequent tri-junction and quad-junction nodes. Pixel thickness is relatively uniform across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible jagged silhouette along the neck and shoulder with high-frequency, low-amplitude peaks.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark-colored birds (oxpeckers) perched on the dorsal ridge and lateral neck surface, causing localized occlusion.
